failure_modes.name: Joint overheat
failure_modes.component: Hip/knee actuator (rotary servo with integrated driver)
failure_modes.symptoms: Joint temperature rising above 70C; torque output derating; thermal warning on control PC; reduced dynamic motion
failure_modes.mitigation: Active cooling / duty-cycle limiting; temperature watchdog with graded torque throttling; periodic grease inspection

failure_modes.name: Encoder drift
failure_modes.symptoms: Position estimate drift during sustained motion; small steady-state joint angle error; calibration needed after power cycle
failure_modes.mitigation: Periodic zero-reference re-homing; redundant hall/IMU cross-check; firmware encoder auto-calibration routine

failure_modes.name: Fall damage
failure_modes.symptoms: Unexpected tip-over; cracked housing; IMU spike; loss of locomotion; joint actuator deformation
failure_modes.mitigation: MPC fall-prevention controller; impact-absorbing covers; graceful fall reflex; pre-gait stability checks

failure_modes.name: Battery connector
failure_modes.symptoms: Intermittent power loss under vibration; voltage sag; sparking at connector; shutdown mid-task
failure_modes.mitigation: Locking latching connectors; torque-checked fasteners; vibration isolation; periodic contact resistance check

failure_modes.name: Hand tendon
failure_modes.symptoms: Reduced grip force; slack or frayed tendon; non-repeatable finger closure; clicking during actuation
failure_modes.mitigation: Scheduled tendon tensioning; wear-limit inspection; lubricated guides; limit grip-force envelope
